picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16, a landmark demonstration for the VENOM program that pushes autonomous air combat from concept toward operational reality.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened a summit uniting UK government, industry, and research leaders to accelerate AI-driven hardware innovation in aerospace, energy, and defence — a high-level bid to reinvigorate national industrial strategy.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center, a significant industry-academia alignment aimed at building regional AI research and talent capacity.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: A major alumnus gift is funding Georgia Tech's new Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, a significant philanthropic bet on AI-based disease prediction and treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: WashU Medicine's C-BRAIN consortium brings together academia and pharmaceutical partners under Randall Bateman to accelerate AI-assisted neurodegenerative disease research at scale.
picks.title: Home

picks.editorial_note: A new UC Santa Barbara–Lawrence Livermore collaboration is applying AI to model extreme plasma physics, with direct relevance to nuclear fusion research and national security science.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell researchers developed an AI method to map and score bone marrow samples, improving diagnostic precision for a serious blood cancer — a concrete clinical advance.
picks.title: Mapping Human Bone Marrow Yields New Tool, Insights on Blood Cancer
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, working with Swiss rail operator SBB and partners at Empa, ETH Zurich, and MIT, built an AI model that improves next-day rail energy demand forecasting, a practical AI deployment with immediate grid impact.
picks.title: Using future data to better predict Switzerland's rail energy demand

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University's GOFLOW system uses AI to reconstruct high-resolution ocean current patterns from satellite data, revealing previously invisible small-scale currents relevant to climate and maritime science.
picks.title: Seeing the Ocean Like Never Before

picks.editorial_note: University of Illinois economists modeled how widespread autonomous trucking could sharply cut transportation costs and redraw the U.S. economic map, a policy-relevant finding for infrastructure and labor planning.
picks.title: Paper: Self-driving trucks will redraw US economic map
